summary: Welcome FAQ footer button alignment bug fix VERIFIED. The red-circled action area (Load more FAQ, Start free trial, Explore platform buttons) now has centered labels inside the buttons on compact/mobile widths. Tested across 5 breakpoints (phone 390px, larger phone 430px, mid mobile 540px, tablet 768px, desktop 1280px). All buttons have justifyContent: center and alignItems: center applied correctly. No horizontal overflow detected. Stacked mobile button layout remains intact.

WelcomeFAQ.tsx lines 337-341: footerButtonText style correctly applies textAlign: 'center' for centered text
WelcomeFAQ.tsx lines 308-315: ctaRow style correctly uses flexDirection: 'column' for compact mobile (width < 560) and 'row' otherwise, with proper centering

context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome FAQ footer button alignment fix verified. Root cause was that FAQ footer buttons were full-width on compact mobile but their internal content was not explicitly centered, so button labels appeared left aligned. Fix applied shared footer button styles with alignItems/justifyContent center and centered text styles for all three FAQ footer actions. Key findings: (1) At 390px: buttons are 316px wide, stacked column layout, labels centered. (2) At 430px: buttons are 356px wide, stacked column layout, labels centered. (3) At 540px: buttons are 466px wide, stacked column layout, labels centered. (4) At 768px tablet: buttons are ~110px wide, inline row layout, labels centered. (5) At 1280px desktop: buttons are ~110px wide, inline row layout, labels centered. Export gate passed per main agent context.
